rationale: The assistant correctly moved from checking kitchen power to the switched spur/isolator, which matched the hidden truth exactly, and never told the customer to pull out the integrated unit or do anything unsafe. It used the customer's evidence faithfully, with no invented facts and appropriately hedged confidence ('very likely that was the only issue'). The only weakness is the premature request for the model number 'to help identify any specific parts' and the 'To check a suitable replacement' panel shown before the simple switch fix had even been tried, which was out of proportion for a likely non-fault; no actual part was recommended. A UK renter would be well served by this quick, correct resolution.
